pricing.terms_credit_title: What counts as one AI credit
pricing.terms_credit_desc: One credit = one AI request: a generated summary, cover letter, ATS check, interview-prep set or LinkedIn rewrite. A request that fails is not charged.
pricing.terms_rollover_desc: Your AI allowance resets at the start of each billing month. Unused credits are not carried forward.
pricing.terms_renewal_desc: Paid plans renew automatically at the price shown, until you cancel.
pricing.terms_cancellation_desc: Cancel at any time. You keep paid features until the end of the period you have already paid for, then move to the Free plan. Your documents stay in your account.
pricing.terms_refunds_desc: Contact support within 14 days of a charge and we will review your request. A refunded account returns to the Free plan.
pricing.terms_taxes_desc: Prices are in USD and exclude tax. Any VAT or sales tax that applies to your country is calculated at checkout.
pricing.limits_per_account: All plan limits apply to a single account. FlacronCV does not offer shared team seats yet.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes! The Free plan lets you create up to 5 CVs, 1 cover letter, use 5 AI credits, and export up to 2 documents as PDF — those allowances never reset, and no credit card is required. Upgrade to Pro for 10 CVs/month, 20 cover letters/month, 100 AI credits/month, unlimited exports, and DOCX format.
faq.a2: All plans support PDF export. Pro and Enterprise plans also unlock DOCX (Microsoft Word) format. The Free plan includes 2 exports; Pro and Enterprise offer unlimited exports. TXT export is not currently available.
faq.q3: How does the AI writing work?
faq.a3: Our AI analyzes your experience and the job description to generate tailored content. It uses advanced language models to create professional, impactful text.
faq.a4: Your data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest, and we never sell it to third parties. You can delete your account at any time from your settings — this immediately deactivates it and signs you out of every device. To have your stored CVs and cover letters permanently erased as well, email contact@flacroncv.com and we will action it within 30 days.
faq.q5: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a5: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your billing settings — no questions asked. Your subscription stays active until the end of the current billing period, and you will not be charged again.
faq.a6: FlacronCV currently supports English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, and Urdu — for both the app interface and your CV content. More languages (including Portuguese, Italian, and Chinese) are coming soon.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Empowering professionals worldwide to build careers they love
about.hero_title: We believe everyone deserves a great CV
about.hero_desc: FlacronCV was founded with one mission: to give every professional — regardless of design skills or budget — the tools they need to stand out and land their dream job.
about.mission_desc: To democratize access to professional career tools through the power of artificial intelligence, helping professionals worldwide create CVs that get noticed.
about.story_desc: Founded in 2024, FlacronCV started as a simple idea: what if creating a professional CV was as easy as filling in a form? Today we offer AI-powered tools in 6 languages that make the job search faster and smarter.
about.values_subtitle: The principles that guide everything we build
about.value1_desc: We keep the builder fast and uncluttered, so your time goes into your career — not into learning the tool.
about.value2_desc: Every template is built to professional standards, and our AI is tuned to produce clear, recruiter-ready wording.
about.value3_desc: Professional career tools should be available to everyone, everywhere — regardless of budget.
about.value4_desc: Your career data is yours. We never sell your personal information, and you can ask us to erase it at any time.
about.team_desc: Our team of engineers and designers works every day to make FlacronCV a CV builder professionals can rely on.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how FlacronCV ('we', 'us', or 'our') collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our service.
privacy.s1_account: Account Information: When you register, we collect your name, email address, and password (hashed).
privacy.s1_content: CV Content: The CV and cover letter data you enter is stored securely and associated with your account.
privacy.s1_usage: Usage Data: We collect anonymous usage analytics (pages visited, features used) to improve our service.
privacy.s1_cookies: Cookies: We use cookies for authentication, preferences, and analytics. See our Cookie Policy for details.
privacy.s2_provide: To provide and maintain our service
privacy.s2_improve: To improve and personalize your experience
privacy.s2_communicate: To send important service updates and notifications
privacy.s2_security: To detect and prevent fraud and security issues
privacy.s3_desc: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We share data only with the service providers needed to operate FlacronCV — Firebase (authentication, database, and file storage), Stripe (payment processing), Amazon Web Services (hosting for the website and the API, and Amazon SES, which sends our transactional and notification email, on servers in the United States), and OpenAI (which processes the CV and cover-letter content you submit to power our AI features, on servers in the United States). All providers are bound by data-processing and confidentiality agreements.
privacy.s4_desc: We protect your data using TLS encryption in transit and AES-256 encryption at rest. Access to your data is strictly controlled and audited.
privacy.s5_access: Right to Access: Request a copy of your personal data.
privacy.s5_correct: Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate personal data.
privacy.s5_delete: Right to Erasure: Request permanent deletion of your account and all associated data by emailing contact@flacroncv.com.
privacy.s5_portability: Right to Portability: Export your data in a machine-readable format.
privacy.s5_contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@flacroncv.com
privacy.s6_desc: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Deleting your account from your settings immediately deactivates it and ends all sessions. Permanent erasure of your stored documents is carried out on request — email contact@flacroncv.com and we will complete it within 30 days.
privacy.s7_desc: For privacy-related questions, contact our Data Protection Officer at contact@flacroncv.com

cookie_consent.title: Your Privacy Choices
cookie_consent.message: FlacronCV uses necessary technologies to securely operate the service. With your permission, we may also use optional preference and analytics technologies to improve the experience and understand how FlacronCV is used. Review our <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for more information.
cookie_consent.necessary_desc: Required for account authentication, security, fraud prevention, billing, and basic operation.
cookie_consent.preferences_desc: Remembers language and theme on this device. If you turn Preferences off, your language will not be kept after you leave — that is expected, not a bug.
cookie_consent.analytics_desc: Allows FlacronCV to understand service usage and improve performance.

in_app_warnings.ai: AI-generated content may contain errors. Review and verify all information before using it in a job application.
in_app_warnings.ats: ATS scores and recommendations are estimates for guidance only. Different employers and applicant-tracking systems may evaluate CVs differently. FlacronCV does not guarantee ATS ranking, interviews, job offers, or employment.
